tools.name: absenceio_list_absences
tools.description: List absence records (leave, sickness and other absences) with paging and an optional filter. absence.io API: POST /api/v2/absences.

tools.name: absenceio_get_absence
tools.description: Get one absence record by its id. absence.io API: GET /api/v2/absences/{id}.

tools.name: absenceio_list_users
tools.description: List users (employees) in the absence.io account, with paging and an optional filter. absence.io API: POST /api/v2/users.

tools.name: absenceio_get_user
tools.description: Get one user (employee) by its id. absence.io API: GET /api/v2/users/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: absenceio_list_absences, absenceio_list_users · Private data: absenceio_list_absences, absenceio_get_absence · Public sink: absenceio_list_absences, absenceio_list_users.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: absenceio_list_absences, absenceio_list_users · Private data: absenceio_list_absences, absenceio_get_absence · Public sink: absenceio_list_absences, absenceio_list_users

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
